steps.prompt: A phone plan costs $\$25$ a month plus $\$0.10$ for each text. Your bill is $\$31$. How many texts did you send, and how did you work it out?

cards.title: Solving a linear equation
cards.body: Do the same thing to both sides until the variable is alone: undo adding or subtracting first, then multiplying or dividing. Clear fractions by multiplying every term by the common denominator. Always check by putting your answer back in.

cards.title: Worked example: brackets on both sides

steps.text: Subtract $3x$ from both sides: $-12 = 2x + 2$. Then subtract $2$ from both sides.

cards.title: Worked example: a word problem
cards.problem: A gym charges a $\$40$ joining fee plus $\$15$ a month. After how many months will the total paid be $\$175$?

steps.text: Let $m$ be the number of months. The fee is the starting amount and $\$15$ is the rate: $40 + 15m = 175$.

cards.title: No solution or infinitely many
cards.body: Collect the $x$ terms on one side. If they cancel and leave something false like $4 = 7$, there is no solution. If they leave something always true like $4 = 4$, every number is a solution. So $ax + b = cx + d$ has no solution when $a = c$ and $b \ne d$.
